name: Moonstruck, Mass (AVV)
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level druid (avv) 9, priestess (avv) 9, sorcerer (avv) /wizard (avv) 9, witch 9
Target One creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell is identical to the spell moonstruck, except that it may affect up to one creature per caster level.
